title: FISH AND SONS KENAI CHARTERS

services.name: Fishing trips
services.desc: Kasilof River steelhead. Big and bold, dime bright and covered in sea lice. Untouched attitude! Fish and Sons offers expert guided Steelhead fishing trips on the Kasilof River, known for its excellent steelhead runs and pristine natural beauty. Their experienced guides provide personalized instruction and assistance, ensuring anglers of all skill levels have a rewarding fishing experience. Trips include access to prime fishing spots along the river, with all necessary gear and safety equipment provided. Whether targeting aggressive steelhead during peak season or enjoying the serene Alaskan wilderness, Fish and Sons delivers a well-organized and memorable adventure ideal for both
